_comment: Trained 4C4D models available to the frontend. Paths are relative to the Global volume ($ATLAS_VOL). checkpoint/config are fixed locations written automatically by atlas-run n3v_repro after training (see DEPLOY.md); if they do not exist, the latest N3V training result matching fallback_glob is used. "title" is the Chinese UI label, "title_en" the English one.
